嗅.def: to sniff, to smell, to scent

ety.hint: To taste 口 an odor 臭; 臭 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 臭 (smell) as the sound and meaning: to sniff. It replaced an older form written with 鼻 (nose) instead of 口.

嗅.name: sniff

ety.hint: A young man 子 carrying an older man 耂

origin.says: 耂 (an old man with long hair) above 子 (child): the young supporting the old, filial piety.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 久 (long time) as the sound, which also suits a lasting illness; later a lasting ache of guilt.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 审 (examine) as the sound: the wife of father's younger brother, an aunt. Simplified from 嬸, with 審 simplified to 审.

溅.def: to sprinkle, to spray, to splash, to spill

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 贱 (cheap) as the sound: to splash. Simplified from 濺.

溅.name: spatter

origin.says: Simplified from 籬: ⺮ (bamboo) for the meaning plus 離 (leave), now 离, as the sound: a fence of bamboo.

筒.def: tube, pipe, cylinder; a thick piece of bamboo

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 同 (tube, its original form) as the sound: a tube, a section of hollow bamboo.

筒.name: bamboo tube

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: the scent of plants, fragrant.

ety.hint: Circulating 巿 water 氵, representing a flood

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 巿 (apron) as the sound: water in full flow, abundant.

砌.def: to pile up, to build; stone steps; rock wall

ety.hint: To cut 切 stone 石; 切 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 切 (cut) as the sound and hint: laying cut stones or bricks to build a wall or steps.

砌.name: lay bricks

哮.def: to cough; to pant; to roar

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 孝 (filial) as the sound: wheezing, panting, roaring.

哮.name: wheeze

躬.def: to bow; personally, in person; oneself

ety.hint: To bow 弓 one's body 身; 弓 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 身 (body) for the meaning plus 弓 (bow) as the sound, which also suggests bending: the body, oneself; to bow.

躬.name: bend body

鞠.def: to bow, to bend; to nourish, to rear

origin.says: One reading: 革 (leather) for the meaning plus 匊 (handful) as the sound, a leather ball. Another: an early form of a word for brewer's yeast, with 米 (rice). It came to mean to bow and to rear.

鞠.name: leather ball

蹋.def: to step on, to tread on

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 𦐇 (an old word, 日 over 羽) as the sound: to tread on.

蹋.name: stamp flat

嘱.def: to instruct, to order, to tell; testament

origin.says: Simplified from 囑: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 屬 (belong), simplified to 属, as the sound: telling someone what to do, to instruct.

嘱.name: enjoin

origin.says: A picture of a shape with a dip in the top: concave, hollow. The opposite of 凸 (convex).
龙 (dragon) as the sound plus 耳 (ear) for the meaning: deaf. Simplified from 聾, with 龍 written 龙.
韦 (tanned leather) for the meaning plus 刃 (blade) as the sound: tough and pliable like leather. Simplified from 韌 by the short form of 韋 (leather).
Traditional 瘧 is 疒 (sickness) plus 虐 (cruel) as the sound: the cruel shaking fever, malaria. The simplified form drops the tiger top of 虐, leaving only its lower part.

挟.def: to seize; to hold to one's bosom

ety.hint: Wedged 夹 in one's arms 扌; 夹 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 挾: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 夾 (squeeze between) as the sound: to hold under the arm, to coerce. 夾 was shortened to 夹.

挟.name: underarm grip

ety.hint: A small 戋 dish 皿; 戋 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 皿 (dish, vessel) for the meaning plus 戋 (small) as the sound: a small cup or lamp dish. Simplified from 盞 (戔 → 戋).

缀.def: to connect, to join; to patch up, to stitch together

ety.hint: To bind 叕 by thread 纟; 叕 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 綴: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 叕 (stitches linked together) as the sound: to stitch together, to join. 糸 is written 纟.

缀.name: stitch on

ety.hint: Blushing 赤 bright red 赤

origin.says: Two 赤 (red) side by side: blazing red, bright; the doubled 赤 also gives the sound.

ety.hint: A person 㔾 being crushed under pressure 厂

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 夹 (press between) as the sound: a chivalrous fighter, a knight-errant. Simplified from 俠 with 夾 shortened.

One reading: 金 (gold, precious) as the sound and 欠 (kneeling open-mouthed person) for the meaning, to revere; another takes 金 as meaning and 欠 as sound. Simplified from 欽 with the short metal side form 钅.

诵.def: to chant, to recite, to repeat, to read aloud

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 甬 (bell) as the sound: to chant or recite aloud. Simplified from 誦, with 言 (speech) written 讠.

诵.name: recite

origin.says: 穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus a sound part: a hole or opening. The traditional form 竅 had 敫 as the sound; the simplified form swapped it for the simpler 巧 (skilful), which sounds similar.

ety.hint: A person with head tilted - leaning forward, running, energetic

origin.says: A drawing of a person with head and arms tilted, as if running or swaying: young, supple; the sense 'to die young' is harder to connect.

夭.name: die young
夭.in: 笑桥跃乔骄侨轿沃妖娇袄矫

匿.def: to hide; to go into hiding

origin.says: 匸 (hiding enclosure), now written 匚, for the meaning plus 若 (as if) as the sound: to hide.

匿.name: go hidden

剔.def: to pick out; to scrape off; picky

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus 易 (easy) as the sound: to scrape off or pick out with a blade.

剔.name: pick out

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 无 (none) as the sound: land overgrown with weeds. Simplified from 蕪 by swapping in 无 for 無.
阝 (hill) for the meaning plus 走 (walk) as the sound: a steep slope; also sudden.

吴.def: one of several warring states; surname

origin.says: Traditional 吳: 口 (mouth) plus a man with his head tilted back: to shout loudly. Now the name of an old state and a surname. The tilted man became 天 (sky) in the modern shape.

吴.name: shouting man

ety.hint: A millet plant 米 bearing grain 覀

origin.says: First a drawing of grain on a plant; later 米 (grain) for the meaning plus 角 (horn) as the sound. The 角 part was worn down over time into 覀 (west-like top).

ety.hint: Someone 亻 who does not bend 屈; 屈 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 屈 (bend) as the sound: a person who will not bend, stubborn.

涤.def: to wash, to sweep; to purify, to cleanse

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 條 (twig), now written 条, as the sound: to wash clean. Simplified from 滌.

涤.name: rinse

ety.hint: A crack 日 dividing two things 小; 阝 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 阝 (mound) plus 𡭴, light (日/白) seen between two halves (小): a crack in a wall. 𡭴 is both meaning and sound.

ety.hint: To run out 氵 of strength 固; 固 also provides the pronunciation

嚷.def: to shout, to roar, to cry; to brawl

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 襄 (assist) as the sound: making a loud noise with the mouth, to shout.

嚷.name: holler

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus a sound part: water surging and roaring. Traditional 洶 uses 匈 as the sound; the simplified form uses the simpler 凶 (ominous), which sounds the same.

ety.hint: A tree 木 bearing berries 叒

origin.says: A picture of a mulberry tree; its leafy crown later became three 又 (hands) above 木 (tree).
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 王 (king) as the sound: deep, wide water, vast.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 刀 (knife) as the sound: talkative, grumbling on and on.

唠.def: to chat, to gossip, to jaw, to talk

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 勞 (toil) as the sound: to chatter on and on. Simplified from 嘮 like 劳.

唠.name: gossip

origin.says: 疒 (illness) for the meaning plus 炎 (blaze) as the sound: phlegm.
力 (strength) for the meaning plus 孛 (sprouting, a comet) as the sound: a sudden vigorous rising, 'thriving, sudden'.

ety.hint: An insect 虫 changing 兑 its skin; 兑 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 虫 (insect, snake) for the meaning plus 兑 (to exchange) as the sound: a creature changing its skin, to molt.
彳 (walking slowly) for the meaning plus 余 (surplus) as the sound: to walk slowly, hence slowly, calmly; also a surname.

纫.def: to sew, to stitch; to thread a needle

ety.hint: To thread 纟 a needle 刃; 刃 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 紉: 糸 (thread) for the meaning plus 刃 (blade, rèn) as the sound: to thread a needle, to sew. 糸 is written 纟.

纫.name: thread needle

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 文 (pattern, wén) as the sound: grudging words, unwilling to give; stingy.

沦.def: sunk, submerged; to perish, to be lost

origin.says: Simplified from 淪: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 侖 as the sound, now 仑: ripples, sinking under water, to fall into ruin.

沦.name: sink away

ety.hint: Water 氵 that cuts like a knife 刃; 止 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 澀: 歰 (four 止 feet, stuck) for the meaning, with 氵 (water) added later: rough, not flowing smoothly. The simplification wrote 歰 as 刃 (blade) over 止 (foot).
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 宛 (winding) as the sound: a sorrowful feeling, regret.
秋 (autumn) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: a heavy, anxious heart, worry.
禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 周 (circuit) as the sound: grain growing close together, hence dense, thick, crowded.

ety.hint: A balance 平 used to measure grain 禾

origin.says: A variant of 称/稱 made for the noun: 禾 (grain) plus 平 (level, balanced): a scale that weighs grain until level, a steelyard.
An old picture whose subject is disputed: a pedestal, a small table, a fish tail or part of a chariot. Used early for the third heavenly stem, so 'third'.
Simplified from 鮑: 鱼 (fish) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound: salted fish, later the abalone. Only the fish part was simplified.

乍.def: first time, for the first time, suddenly

origin.says: An early drawing, read as a tool chopping or cutting (one reading: an axe on wood, another: stitching a collar). It first meant "to make" (now 作); borrowed for "suddenly, at first".

乍.name: abruptly

origin.says: Simplified from 狽: 犭 (dog, beast) for the meaning plus 貝 (shell money) as the sound: a legendary wolf, in 狼狈 (in a sorry state). 貝 became 贝.

ety.hint: A cloth 衤 wrap 包; 包 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound and hint: a long wrapping garment, a robe.

ety.hint: 亠, 口, and 冖 form a picture of a pavilion; 丁 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: The top of 高 (tall), a tower building, for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound: a pavilion or small roadside lodge.

侥.def: to be lucky; by chance, by luck

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: a person who gets lucky by chance. Simplified from 僥, with 堯 written as 尧.

侥.name: lucky chance

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 姑 (aunt) as the sound: a mushroom.

拣.def: to choose, to select; to gather, to pick up

origin.says: Simplified from 揀: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 柬 (pick out) as the sound, which also gives the meaning; 柬 is written in a cursive short form. To pick out by hand.

拣.name: sort by hand

ety.hint: A bountiful 丰 place 阝

origin.says: 阝 (a town, from 邑) for the meaning plus 丰 (lush plant) as the sound: a state or country. Probably the same word as 封 (to grant land).
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 乞 (to beg) as the sound: a lump on the skin, pimple, wart.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 眇 (small, one-eyed) as the sound and a hint of tininess: a vast water where things look tiny and far.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 荅 (small bean) as the sound: a late character used in 疙瘩 (lump, pimple).
